Paper Baseline / Defect: Printed logic inversion: loop terminated when direction equaled next packet
Project Modernization: Fixed loop exit to terminate when direction != next OR timePassed > timeout (1ms)
Demonstrated Benefit: Prevents fragmentation into single-packet clumps; restores physical burst clumping

Paper Baseline / Defect: Algorithm 1 line 9 accessed packets[counter] after incrementing counter past end
Project Modernization: Strict array bounds check: if counter >= len(packets): break before indexing
Demonstrated Benefit: Zero index-out-of-bounds crashes during packet ingestion

Paper Baseline / Defect: 80/20 random flow split mixed packets from identical capture sessions in train/test
Project Modernization: Group-disjoint 70/15/15 split strictly partitioning session and scenario IDs
Demonstrated Benefit: Measures true generalization against unseen adversaries, eliminating optimistic leakage

Paper Baseline / Defect: Paper used arbitrary default threshold (0.5), yielding unquantified false alarm rates
Project Modernization: Platt scaling fit strictly on validation split to satisfy target FPR <= 0.001 (0.1%)
Demonstrated Benefit: Prevents operational alert fatigue in enterprise networks with high traffic volume
